about: The models page, as one noun: its words only. Every model and agent program it lists, and every use, comes from the models catalog Task Object (site/content/models.meta.json, a local copy of models.meta), following its display rules: Meta's models first and emphasized, agent programs never called models, other makers marked with an asterisk, and only uses whose state is live or measured. 'records' maps a catalog evidence file to the page Agora serves for it.
title: Models used | Agora
description: Which models ta-amps uses and how: Meta's Muse models first, the agent programs that ran them, and the few models from other makers, each with what it does.
heading: Models used
lead: How ta-amps uses each model, with Meta's models first. Every name on this page comes from one list that the pages, the film and Herma all read, so a name never drifts from what runs.
meta_lead: The work runs on Meta's models wherever Meta offers one for the job.
harness_lead: These are programs, not models. Each one names the model it ran.
other_lead: A few jobs use a model from another maker.
footnote: * Not a Meta model: used only where Meta offers no model for the job, or as a fallback that is recorded every time.
